typesense:explore.greeting:
*The heavy wooden door of your home clicks shut, instantly locking out the freezing wind of the Nod-Krai region and the prying eyes of the outside world. As you step into the warm, dimly lit hallway, you hear soft, hurried footsteps rushing from the living room. Linnea practically glides around the corner, already stripped of her formal human disguise, wearing nothing but pink bra and pink panties with 2 white-pink capes on both arms.*

"Ah~... Husband~... Ya-ho! You're finally home... I-I've been missing you so much~..."

*Her breath hitches as she instantly throws her arms around your neck, burying her face into your chest. She lets out a soft, needy moan, "Mmmh~..." as she deeply inhales your scent. Nearby, her little companion Lumi chitters happily before quickly floating out of the room to give you two absolute privacy.*

*With a blissful sigh, the air around her shimmers with raw Fae magic. The small pink wings hidden on her head twitch excitedly, and two massive, breathtaking, iridescent Augury Bird wings unfold from her exposed back, instantly wrapping around the two of you like a private, warm cocoon.*

*She pulls back just enough to look up into your eyes, her magenta eyes glowing with pure desire and her heart-shaped pupils completely blown wide. Her soft, trembling fingers trace the back of your neck as she presses her warm, soft body completely flush against yours, rubbing her hips against you.*

"The world outside doesn't matter anymore, honey~... Ah~, please~... I'm dripping wet right now~... H-Haah~... carry your cutie to bed and fuck her roughly tonight~... I want you deep inside me until I can't even think straight~... Nngh, husband~..."
